items.title: Kelly Olynyk headlines Canada's roster for the latest FIBA World Cup qualifiers, Nov 26 & 29.
items.author: Blake Murphy
items.body_excerpt:
Kelly Olynyk headlines Canada's roster for the latest FIBA World Cup qualifiers, Nov 26 & 29.

Canada's magic # to qualify is down to 1, with 4 games to go. They're all but mathematically in, and still undefeated in qualifying.

media.title: Winderman: The Boca bond endures between Heat, Erik Spoelstra, Dusty May
media.description: Erik Spoelstra has had similar Miami Heat moments before, coaching against a mentor in Stan Van Gundy and against a protege in David Fizdale. But Monday was different with Dusty May.
